title: System by Dave profile
description: A description of real equipment, a venue, a position or a workflow. Shared equipment profiles live in profiles/<kind>/<id>.json; client-owned venue, position and workflow profiles live in clients/<client>/profiles/<kind>/<id>.json. Client profiles reference shared profiles by ID and never copy their values. Every value carries evidence. See docs/client-framework.md.

kind.description: Profile kind. Shared kinds describe equipment; client kinds describe a place or a practice.

version.description: Profile major version. References pin the major (@1). Bump it when a value's meaning or unit changes; correcting a value or its evidence is not a bump.

owner.description: 'shared' for top-level profiles/, otherwise the owning client id. A shared profile may not reference a client profile.

extends.description: Profiles this one composes, by role, e.g. { "camera": "camera/birddog-p240@1" } in a position profile. Resolution is by reference only; values are never copied.

values.description: Every leaf value is wrapped with its evidence. Units are explicit and SI unless the key says otherwise.

private.description: True when the source (e.g. a venue photo) must not be published. Only its identifier appears in the profile.

unit.description: Unit of value, or 'none' for dimensionless or categorical values.

evidence.description: Same vocabulary as the FMP Camera Simulator (apps/fmp-camera-sim/src/domain/evidence.ts), so its records migrate without translation.
